name: Baotek Industrial Materials Ltd.
summary: Baotek Industrial Materials Ltd. manufactures and sells fiberglass fabrics for copper clad laminates of various electronic applications. It provides industrial glass fiber products comprising aerospace fiberglass fabric, a reinforcement material for airplanes' internal structure; high temperature filter bag used in power and steel plants, incinerators, and cement factories; fiberglass sunshades for use in buildings, interior designs, construction, and furniture; and PTFE fabrics for use in PTFE coating areas.
